name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering in university, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion for the intricate details and high stakes of the sport. He specialized in paint technology, recognizing the crucial role it plays in aerodynamics and team branding. After graduating, Kenji honed his skills at smaller racing outfits, learning the ropes and developing a keen eye for detail.

Now at Williams Racing, Kenji brings a methodical and innovative approach to the paint shop. He's constantly researching new materials and techniques to improve the durability, weight, and aerodynamic properties of the car's paint. Kenji understands that every coat of paint matters, and he takes pride in contributing to the team's performance, one meticulously finished panel at a time. His calm demeanor allows him to thrive under pressure, ensuring deadlines are met without compromising quality.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing safety glasses.

quirks: Has a habit of humming quietly while working, usually traditional Japanese folk songs.
Keeps a miniature zen garden on his workbench for moments of reflection.
